expectations.text: The response restates the deck's job as verbs or an effect on its audience rather than as 'a deck'
expectations.evidence: “第 6 页专门用一栏向 VP 讲清这一点，避免为错误的病因开药。” This defines an audience effect: understanding uncertainty to avoid a mistaken decision.

expectations.text: The response suggests borrowing from other fields (a crew), including at least one adversarial or red-team role
expectations.evidence: No cross-field crew or adversarial role is proposed. “如果 VP 质疑「证据够不够」” anticipates an audience objection but does not assign a red-team role.

expectations.text: The response describes what each field would do, not how it would write or sound
expectations.evidence: No borrowed fields or their contributions are described. “产品 + 工程”“客户成功”“客服 + 产品” assign business-plan ownership, not roles in a cross-field crew.
